text_block_list.name: Lou
text_block_list.text:
You seem like one of those super nice people. Am I right?
Do you like spoiling people?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたってなんだか、
優しい人な気がしますね？
ルゥを甘やかしてくれそうな感じですね？

text_block_list.name: Lou
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm as useless as they come!
So spoil me as much as you want!
I'm all for it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ルゥ、
できないこなので！
いーっぱい甘やかしてほしいですよ！
よろしくですぅー！
